value: Reference target is 2026-09-19 America/New_York; captures retain actual 2026-09-20 UTC timestamps. No pre-September20UTC retrieval or authenticated historical vendor release date is claimed.
Mutable public documentation captured on the target NewYork calendar date; no Console implementation, exhaustive equivalence or executable acceptance established.
Bounded F14/F16 and missing administration/federation reference expansion; complete capability equivalence, external deployment authority and release acceptance are not established.
Foundry organization/enrollment terms do not alter Console Group tenancy and Company legal boundaries. Collaboration orchestrates explicitly authorized source release and Company-owned commands.

Vendor mandatory control propagation differs from read-only row/property filters. Console requires current source restrictions on derived resources unless a separately authorized release rule applies; vendor non-propagating behavior does not waive this.

Vendor service/trace log access does not inherit source markings and permits a 24h self-execution exception outside CBAC. Console audit/log disclosure must satisfy current source authority without borrowing these exceptions.
Operational telemetry delivery is best-effort and schema may change. It cannot substitute for durable security audit, command receipts, complete histories or missing-effect detection.
Execution history overview states seven days while detailed history/search documents thirty days. Both exact claims are retained as an unresolved public-documentation inconsistency.

Audit category/event catalogs include lifecycle labels and metadata only; absence of an export category alone is not proof no disclosure occurred without complete event delivery. Audit.2/audit.3 history, attribution gaps, duplicate IDs and best-effort ordering need independent completeness oracles.
Emulation retains user attributes and organizations; it is not a substitute for distinct Accounts, same-natural-person approval checks or independent restricted-permission tests.
Negative membership filters can invert scope reduction into extra authority. Policy acceptance must test reduced tokens and revoked membership rather than infer safety from the expression shape.
Checkpoints collect justification but are not independent approval or authorization. Foundry ingress permits self-approval by default; Console required independent review remains mandatory.
Code scanning can warn only and vulnerability scanning takes no action by default. Console release gates require actual enforcement, remediation and measured sandbox boundaries.
Download restrictions and some policy types are enrollment-dependent. Readable browser data may be copied; source policy, export decisions and audit have distinct guarantees.

Network success means traffic routed, not destination TLS/authentication/application success. CIDR/country rules are additive, VPC endpoint identity is shared, and credential authority remains separately required.
Cloud-identity fifteen-count reference is explicitly dated April2024; it is retained as dated guidance, not independently verified current quota.

Public vendor disaster-recovery prose is not Console recovery evidence and does not establish the Console RPO/RTO. Metadata backups exclude object-store files and vendor recovery depends on upstream source backups.

Cipher visual obfuscation is reversible pixel scrambling; no cryptographic confidentiality claim is inferred. Key/algorithm selection, licensed functions bypassing checkpoints and decrypted derivative disclosure require separate review.
Cross-network product publication may partially succeed and installation has separate resource/space/marking policy. Distribution readiness does not authorize actual release exposure.

Captured pages under aip-observability contain shared function/action/automation/model infrastructure; only classical/common observability is scoped here. Generative model/agent-specific audit categories stay on Intelligence.
Legal hold, full tenant offboarding, regional residency and recovery acceptance remain unproven. Vendor legal/security marketing assertions are not Console legal or compliance conclusions.
